content: The way to get started is to quit talking and begin doing.
author: Walt Disney

content: Don’t worry about failure; you only have to be right once.
author: Drew Houston

content: It's not about ideas. It's about making ideas happen.
author: Scott Belsky

content: Move fast and break things. Unless you are breaking stuff, you are not moving fast enough.
author: Mark Zuckerberg

content: Your time is limited, so don’t waste it living someone else’s life.
author: Steve Jobs

content: Risk more than others think is safe. Dream more than others think is practical.
author: Howard Schultz

content: Ideas are easy. Implementation is hard.
author: Guy Kawasaki

content: Chase the vision, not the money. The money will end up following you.
author: Tony Hsieh

content: If you’re not embarrassed by the first version of your product, you’ve launched too late.
author: Reid Hoffman

content: Fail often so you can succeed sooner.
author: Tom Kelley

content: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
author: Mark Twain

content: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: It is the courage to continue that counts.
author: Winston Churchill

content: Timing, perseverance, and ten years of trying will eventually make you look like an overnight success.
author: Biz Stone

content: The best way to predict the future is to create it.
author: Peter Drucker

content: Stay self-funded as long as possible.
author: Garrett Camp

content: If you define yourself by how you differ from the competition, you're probably in trouble.
author: Omar Hamoui

content: Don’t be cocky. Don’t be flashy. There’s always someone better than you.
author: Tony Hsieh

content: Make every detail perfect and limit the number of details to perfect.
author: Jack Dorsey

content: You don’t learn to walk by following rules. You learn by doing and falling over.
author: Richard Branson

content: Entrepreneurship is neither a science nor an art. It is a practice.
author: Peter Drucker

content: If you just work on stuff that you like and you’re passionate about, you don’t have to have a master plan.
author: Mark Zuckerberg

content: Don’t count the days, make the days count.
author: Muhammad Ali

content: The most dangerous poison is the feeling of achievement. The antidote is to every evening think what can be done better tomorrow.
author: Ingvar Kamprad

content: All humans are entrepreneurs not because they should start companies but because the will to create is encoded in human DNA.
author: Reid Hoffman

content: Be so good they can’t ignore you.
author: Steve Martin

content: As long as you're going to be thinking anyway, think big.
author: Donald Trump

content: The only place where success comes before work is in the dictionary.
author: Vidal Sassoon

content: Start where you are. Use what you have. Do what you can.
author: Arthur Ashe

content: Don’t let others convince you that the idea is good when your gut tells you it’s bad.
author: Kevin Rose

content: Success usually comes to those who are too busy to be looking for it.
author: Henry David Thoreau
